The modifications in `hid-logitech-dj.h` and `hid-logitech-dj.c` are closely related as they work together to address the issue of missing control packets during the enumeration process of Logitech devices. The addition of the `querying_devices` flag allows the driver to manage the state of device querying effectively. The changes in `hid-logitech-dj.c` implement the logic to handle incoming reports from unknown devices by triggering a re-enumeration process, ensuring that the driver can recover from the state where it has discarded important control packets due to the race condition introduced in a previous commit. Overall, these modifications enhance the robustness of the device enumeration process and ensure that all necessary control packets are processed correctly.
